jobs.experience: Not stated in available listing data
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

We are seeking an experienced Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA to lead new business acquisition across EMEA. We are investing aggressively to capture the Enterprise opportunity in front of us, and we are moving upmarket fast. We are looking for a builder: someone who will pave the way upmarket and build a real Enterprise sales playbook from the ground up, rather than inherit one.

Our segmentation reflects where we are on that journey. Enterprise is currently defined as companies with 400 or more employees, which makes it a broad segment. You will lead a team running a high volume of mid-sized deals at the lower end alongside the larger, complex enterprise deals at the top. Building a single motion that serves both, without compromising either, is one of the central challenges of this role.

What you’ll do as a Head of Enterprise Sales, EMEA at Vanta:

 - Define and build the Enterprise motion in EMEA: setting a clear multi-year vision aligned to GTM objectives, creating the playbook, processes, and deal strategy behind it, and evolving it as the market shifts

 - Own the EMEA Enterprise number, driving pipeline generation, win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, and quota attainment

 - Get hands-on in your team's most strategic deals, joining customer conversations, coaching in the moment, and helping close the deals that set the standard for what Enterprise looks like at Vanta

 - Hire, mentor, and develop your Managers and AEs as the team scales, and create clear career paths into Enterprise and leadership roles

 - Deliver an accurate weekly forecast, and build the inspection cadence, deal reviews and pipeline hygiene that make it trustworthy

 - Partner with senior sales leadership, marketing, RevOps, product marketing, partnerships and enablement to align the region around a unified GTM strategy

 - Bring the voice of the EMEA Enterprise buyer back into the business, influencing product priorities, pricing, packaging and regional investment

 - Represent Vanta at industry events and customer meetings across the region

How to be successful in this role:

 - Proven, repeated track record as a builder: creating Enterprise playbooks from scratch rather than inheriting them, and taking a company or region upmarket from mid-market roots

 - Experience leading frontline sales leaders at a SaaS company.

 - Consistent record of achieving and exceeding Enterprise new business targets across multiple EMEA markets, with a real understanding of how buying behavior, procurement and security review differ across the region

 - Comfort operating across a broad segment, from a high volume of mid-sized deals through to large, complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals

 - Mastery of a value-based selling methodology such as Command of the Message, and the ability to coach it rather than just quote it

 - Rigorous command of the key metrics of the business: uses data to diagnose issues, prioritize investment and forecast accurately, and builds business cases that influence executive stakeholders

 - Strong executive presence: builds credible relationships with CISOs, CIOs and other senior buyers, and communicates strategy, performance and investment plans to senior leadership with clarity

 - Strong eye for talent, both in hiring and in advancing the careers of Vantans

 - Comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to create clarity for a team through periods of rapid growth and change

 - Enthusiasm for cybersecurity and for helping customers build trusted businesses

 - Open to using AI to amplify their skills and strengthen their work - demonstrating curiosity, a willingness to learn, and sound judgment in applying AI responsibly to improve efficiency and impact.

This role requires an in-office hybrid schedule, with 3 days per week in the Dublin office.

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

 - Commuter benefits for team members who attend the office

 - Pension matching

 - 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

 - 8 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-hybrid

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonst

jobs.title: Senior Manager, People Operations and Total Rewards
jobs.experience: 10+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Role Overview

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation to be on site at least 2 days per week in our Cork office.

This role sits at the intersection of people operations and total rewards, with global scope and genuine ownership. You will manage the systems, processes, and programmes that underpin how we attract, retain, and reward our people worldwide bringing operational rigour and strategic thinking in equal measure.

You will work closely with HR leadership, Finance, and Legal, acting as a trusted partner to HRBPs and business leaders globally. You will play a central role in driving the AI-enabled transformation of the People function - identifying opportunities to automate workflows, augment decision-making, and redesign how the team operates day to day using emerging AI tools and capabilities.

Responsibilities

People Operations

 - Lead the AI transformation of People Operations evaluating, piloting, and embedding AI tools across the employee lifecycle, from onboarding and policy management to compensation modelling and people analytics, and building the team's capability to work effectively alongside AI.

 - Own and continuously improve global HR operations including HRIS (UKG) administration, data integrity, process documentation, and AI-enabled workflow automation - ensuring a seamless employee experience at every stage of the lifecycle.

 - Manage and evolve HR policies globally, ensuring compliance with local employment law across multiple jurisdictions while maintaining consistency in global people practices. 

 - Build and maintain people analytics reporting to support data-driven decisions by HR leadership and business partners.

 - Own the People team's technology stack, working closely with IT and Data teams to integrate systems, safeguard data, and unlock new capabilities.

 - Manage and develop a small global team, setting priorities and building capability across time zones.  

Total Rewards

 - Lead the design, administration, and communication of global compensation programmes - including salary structures, bonus plans, and equity ensuring they are competitive, equitable, and aligned to business strategy.

 - Own and evolve the benefits portfolio with responsibility for managing vendor relationships, renewals, and regional programme design. As the company continues to grow, this role will play a key part in extending our benefits offering into additional regions ensuring local market norms and regulatory requirements are met at every stage.

 - Drive the annual compensation review cycle end-to-end, from market benchmarking and budget modelling to manager guidance and employee communications.

 - Conduct and interpret compensation benchmarking surveys (Radford) to keep pay ranges current and defensible, and advise on offer competitiveness and internal equity.

 - Lead pay equity analysis and gender pay gap reporting.

Required Qualifications

 - 10+ years of progressive HR experience, with meaningful depth in both people operations and compensation and/or benefits.

 - Proficiency with HRIS platforms (UKG, Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, or equivalent) and strong analytical skills - comfortable building models and presenting data-driven recommendations.

 - Total compensation design and strategy experience, including salary structures, bonus plans, equity (RSUs, stock options), and benefits with the ability to architect, communicate, and govern total reward frameworks in a global, multi-jurisdiction environment.

 - Technology or hardware industry is preferred, with familiarity with the compensation structures, equity programmes, and talent dynamics typical of a global tech environment.

 - Experience applying AI tools to HR processes whether through workflow automation, predictive analytics, or process redesign with a practical, hands-on approach to identifying and implementing new capabilities.

 - Understanding of global employment law, including Irish employment legislation, GDPR, and the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

 - Experience managing global benefits programmes across multiple countries and vendors, with an understanding of regional market norms.

 - Clear, confident communication - able to translate complex compensation mechanics into plain language for managers and employees, and present recommendations credibly to senior stakeholders.

 - Strong project management skills - able to lead programmes from design to delivery, manage multiple workstreams, and follow through consistently.

 - Collaborative and inclusive working style - effective across time zones, able to build trust with distributed teams.

 - Proven experience managing and developing a small team, with the ability to set direction, coach individuals, and drive performance in a global environment.
   
   

Preferred Qualifications

 - A third-level qualification in Human Resources, Business, Finance, or a related field is desirable, though equivalent professional experience and/or CIPD qualification will be equally considered.

 - Experience in a US-headquartered company.

Eligibility to live and work in Ireland is required. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. We’re looking for a dynamic and empowering Sales Development Manager who will be responsible for building and leading a team of enterprise ADRs. The role focuses on leadership, development and a high performance culture to execute against our rapid sales goals.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

The Opportunity

In this role, you will have two core priorities: Talent Development & Revenue Development. We view our Account Development Representatives as the next wave of Account Executives at MongoDB. A Sales Development leader at MongoDB hires outstanding talent, maps out the gaps in that rep’s skillset, holds them accountable to reaching their potential, and takes pride in turning that ADR into an AE. You will also be a key asset to our Enterprise Sales organization, partnering with regional leaders across our sales organization, you will be a crucial part of uncovering new opportunities, determining how to unlock new territories, and driving revenue into our pipeline.

• Invest in your self-development, focusing on the skills and attributes that will make you successful in your core role and get you set for future success

What You Will Bring to the Table

• 2+ years experience prospecting as an individual contributor and closing

• 2+ years experience leading/managing with a track record in hiring, developing and promoting

• Complex enterprise software experience in a comparable company (technical and multi level decision making)

• Experience in open source software sales is a distinct advantage

• Excellent verbal, written, listening, and presentation skills. You must be credible with direct reports, customers, recruitment candidates, and internally across the organization at all levels including senior management

• Top performer, Results oriented, with a track record of overachievement (President’s Club, Rep of the Year, etc.)

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

jobs.experience: 6+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Senior Payroll Specialist to serve as a subject matter expert on our Global Payroll team, with ownership of payroll operations across LATAM (Brazil and Mexico). Reporting to the Senior Payroll Manager, this role partners closely with HR, Finance, and external vendors to ensure accurate, compliant, and timely payroll delivery.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Cork for our hybrid working model.

Responsibilities:

• Prepare and review advance, monthly and supplemental payrolls for our LATAM operations including salary, equity, benefits, and variable pay

• Manage Brazil 13º salário (13th month salary), férias (vacation), and rescisão (termination) calculations and payments

• Manage Mexico Christmas Bonus, profit sharing and terminations calculations and payments 

• Single point of contact (POC) for all LATAM issues. Resolve all issues in a timely manner and within global payroll SLAs

• Reconcile payroll and support monthly/quarterly/annual accounting close processes

• Build internal LATAM payroll expertise, reducing reliance on external consultants through hands-on guidance and more efficient processes

• Issue union due slips and submit for payment 

• Prepare the income tax DARF and reconcile the amounts according to the appropriate period

• Deep, current knowledge of Brazilian labor law (CLT), social security and tax obligations, and the eSocial/FGTS Digital ecosystem

• Own LATAM payroll-related employee lifecycle processes, including onboarding, vacations and terminations, ensuring accurate and timely execution

• Partner with Legal, Finance, and HR on termination processing, CBA (Dissidio) and any other processes as required

• Ensure we are meeting annual compliance requirements; assist the Payroll Tax Team with any audits and year-end compliance reporting

• Train junior payroll staff; document and continuously improve payroll SOPs

• Automate processes to enhance scalability and efficiency of payroll operations

• Ensure SOX compliance with all payroll operation processes

• All other duties and responsibilities, as assigned

Skills and Qualifications:

• Fluent in Portuguese (a must) and Spanish (a plus)

• Experience with Brazil and Mexico end to end payroll 

• Experience with Brazil payroll statutory obligations is required, i.e. hands-on experience with eSocial, FGTS Digital, INSS, IRRF and related filings

• Advance proficiency with MS Word, Excel, Google Applications

• Experience with ADP Celergo and SuccessFactors is a plus

• Minimum 6+years of LATAM payroll experience

• Subject matter expert in Brazil compliance and regulation including but not limited to vacation, collective bargaining agreements, 13th month salary calculations etc

• Ability to partner and collaborate with various stakeholders to fulfill common goals

• Strong verbal and written communication skills required to clearly communicate complex payroll matters to both employees and stakeholders

jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the marketing agent layer as a product: the agents marketers interact with, the marketing workflows those agents execute, and the context that makes agentic output reliable. You will treat the marketing organization as your user base and the agent layer as your product.

This is a build-together role. The agent layer runs on an orchestration and execution tier owned by the Marketing Automation team. You articulate which workflows go agentic, in what order, and why; the Automation team decides how agents are allowed to act in systems of record and owns the path from prototype to production. You bring the product discipline, the user understanding and the delivery cadence. The ideal candidate has shipped AI in internal systems teams, has product ownership experience, and understands how a B2B marketing organization plans, executes, and measures campaigns.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Key Responsibilities

• Own the product roadmap for the marketing agent layer: prioritize use cases by business impact, feasibility and risk, and propose delivery sequencing

• Map marketing processes end to end, identify where agents remove or reshape steps, and publish the target-state process before an agent is built

• Write requirements, acceptance criteria, and success metrics for each agent workflow, and define the system actions each workflow needs

• Co-author the agent governance standard with other marketing technology teams

• Run cross-functional forums to surface dependencies, resolve blockers and keep Marketing, Data and platform teams aligned

• Own user communication and backlog impact when agents fail

• Measure and report adoption, roadmap status, risks and decisions to stakeholders from individual contributors to executives in plain language

• Drive adoption across marketing with enablement, documentation, office hours and feedback loops

• Understanding of the marketing stack (marketing automation, CRM, CDP, product analytics, orchestration and BI) and how marketing teams use it end to end

• Track record of taking a capability from prototype to adopted standard across a large organization, with evidence that adoption persisted

• Comfort working with data: defining KPIs, querying or reading analytics, and using data to make prioritization decisions

• Track record of delivering through teams you do not manage: aligning platform owners, engineers and security on a shared design and keeping momentum without direct authority

• Clear written and verbal communication across technical and business audiences

jobs.description:
Help Datadog reach and engage priority talent through targeted campaigns, programmes and experiences. In this hands-on role, you will build relationships with internal and external audiences and help people connect with relevant opportunities at Datadog..

You will own agreed programmes from planning through delivery and evaluation. Working with the Director of Employer Brand, your regional counterpart in NYC, Recruiting, Employer Brand and Content, and Growth Marketing, you will turn hiring priorities into focused campaigns, useful experiences and clear next steps for participants.

Redesigning programme delivery through AI-native, agentic workflows is a core responsibility. You will turn effective approaches into regular practice and demonstrate improvements in quality, speed and delivery capacity.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

 

What You’ll Do:

• Build and deliver an agreed portfolio of engagement programmes aligned with hiring priorities. Define the audience, objectives, budget and success measures. Anticipate peaks and quieter periods in event demand, balance events with ongoing programmes, and recommend what to prioritise, reduce or stop within available capacity.

• Redesign engagement programme delivery with agentic workflows. Build, test and improve workflows that use AI agents for segmentation, nurture, follow-up coordination and reporting. Set human review and approval points with relevant partners, protect candidate and employee data, and measure improvements in quality, turnaround time and delivery capacity.

• Run internal marketing and network activation programmes.

• Build segmented nurture journeys that connect talent communities, event attendees and relevant past candidates, including strong candidates whose timing is not yet right. Personally write, build and send newsletters and email campaigns using agreed messaging and assets.

• Plan and deliver targeted events and experiences, including referral sessions, small-group dinners, executive experiences and virtual formats.

• Create practical briefings, playbooks and activation materials that help recruiters, hiring managers and employees use Datadog's talent messaging, content and networks.

• Deliver agreed campaigns with Recruiting and People partners that help employees discover relevant internal opportunities.

• Coordinate programme delivery across regions with your counterpart and Recruiting partners. 

• Own the delivery and improvement of engagement programmes. Partner with Brand and Content to apply talent messaging and adapt assets for your audiences. Work with Recruiting on candidate engagement and progression.

• Work with Creative, Field Marketing, Community and business leaders where programmes require their involvement.

• Establish baselines and evaluate programme performance. Work to improve tracking and use the findings to improve programmes and recommend where to invest, adapt or stop.

 

Who You Are: 

• Hands-on experience in recruitment marketing, lifecycle marketing, community marketing, or recruiting solutions, with programmes you have personally built, launched and improved.

• Experience delivering targeted events and integrated campaigns for clearly defined audiences.

• Practical experience with audience segmentation, nurture journeys and CRM or marketing automation tools.

• Strong writing and creative judgement, including the ability to turn a message into useful campaigns, emails and activation materials.

• Experience managing programme budgets, timelines and competing priorities, with clear recommendations when capacity is constrained.

• Confidence interpreting performance data, understanding attribution limits and using evidence to influence stakeholders.

• The ability to build relationships with senior partners, secure commitments and coordinate delivery across teams and regions.

• The ability to rethink programme delivery, test AI agents and automation, and turn effective approaches into repeatable workflows with appropriate human review.

Nice to Have

• Experience in a high-growth technology company.

• Familiarity with recruiting operations and applicant tracking systems.

 

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

 

Benefits and Growth:

• Best-in-breed onboarding

• Generous global benefits

• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

As a Sales Development Manager at Stripe, you'll drive Stripe's future growth engine by leading a team of inbound and outbound SDRs. You'll work with Stripe's Sales teams to build Stripe's sales pipeline. As a Sales Development Manager, you'll lead and coach a group of high-performing SDRs, helping them deliver on ambitious targets, as well as work directly with the team. We're looking for a self-starter who has demonstrated success dealing with ambiguity, operating in a high-growth environment, and solving problems with limited oversight. Ideal candidates will have management experience scaling a technology Sales Development team and superior communication skills.

We take a data-driven, problem-solving approach to Sales Development, and look for someone who enjoys building—who will actively participate in the development of sales processes, the articulation of Stripe's value proposition, and the creation of key tools and assets to measure success. Stripe is not a typical company, and this is not a typical sales development function. If you're hungry, smart, persistent, and a great teammate, we want to hear from you.

What you'll do

Responsibilities

• Recruit, train, and lead a rapidly growing team of SDRs

• Contribute to both the long-term vision and strategy for the team and manage day-to-day operations

• Own and drive execution of Stripe's new business pipeline goals by understanding and analyzing top-of-the-funnel metrics, pipeline quality, and revenue influenced across different segments

• Coach, mentor, and guide the team in developing consultative and solution-based sales skills including campaign strategy, outbound execution, and nurturing interest in opportunities

• Shape deep partnerships with Marketing, Sales, Sales Operations, Enablement, and Product Marketing teams to successfully collaborate on campaigns and events

• Optimize your business for efficiency, accelerate ramp time to productivity, and ensure your team has a crisp understanding of Stripe domain knowledge

• Effectively work cross-functionally across the organization to shape Stripe's solutions to meet client needs

• Inspire, motivate, and enable individual development to promote career growth of direct reports

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 2+ years of people management experience

• Experience leading inbound and outbound sales and operations in an early-stage, high-growth technology environment

• Proven track record of high performance in a pipeline-generating or closing role

• Ability to hire, train, and coach a high-performance sales team

• Ability to build relationships with strategic clients and industry thought leaders

• Demonstrated passion for startups and new technology businesses

• Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts and build great relationships with highly technical customers

• Demonstrated experience in leading and managing comprehensive program management initiatives to ensure successful project execution and alignment with organizational objectives

• Experience working with AI inactive data, understanding its implications, and developing strategies for effective management and utilization

Preferred qualifications

• Prior experience at a growth-stage internet or software company

• Fluency in any other European language is a plus

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Who we are

About Stripe

About the team

The Sales Compensation team at Stripe is responsible for the overall compensation strategy, design, and payment administration for the global sales organization. We ensure that our objectives align with the compensation program and that our sales teams are paid accurately and on time. We provide thought leadership for the go-to-market initiatives so that performance and compensation are effectively correlated. The Sales Compensation team partners closely with the revenue-generating and support functions across Stripe to support the success of our sales efforts.

What you'll do

You're a key contributor to the sales compensation program design, implementation, and performance assessment of the sales organization. You'll have high visibility across multiple channels, owning the performance-to-compensation structure for specific sales teams and serving as the subject matter expert for strategic advice and implementation of any compensation programs (including SPIFFs and MBOs) that further align the sales focus with our OKRs.

You're passionate about sales compensation and comfortable working in ambiguous situations to identify optimal solutions for our sales teams to succeed. You have experience working across all levels and functions of an organization (preferably in a high-growth environment) to align our priorities with our sales team's motivation. You bring resilience and the ability to both partner and lead in cross-functional situations. You use analytics and quantitative data to support and evaluate decisions.

Responsibilities

• Lead the annual sales compensation plan design cycle for specific sales teams, including obtaining input and stakeholder approval for the proposed compensation structures

• Implement metrics for the plans that are specific, measurable, and align with company priorities

• Own the rollout and enablement of the compensation plans

• Conduct frequent quantitative measurement of the compensation plan effectiveness and apply learnings to the annual plan design process

• Propose, evaluate, design, and measure the effectiveness of SPIFFs

• Be the main contact for sales leadership to correlate objectives and compensation

• Own, update, and lead the enablement of the sales compensation resources for the sales organization

• Own, update, and lead the enablement of the annual sales credit policies for the sales organization

• Represent the sales compensation impacts in company strategy discussions (e.g., with Product)

• Have an in-depth understanding of the sales function, product priorities, and individual sales team characteristics

• Support the commission calculation close process as needed

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• BS or BA in Business, Finance, Economics, Math, or Statistics

• At least five years of experience in a sales compensation role

• At least two years as a key point of contact with senior Sales, Finance, and HR leadership

• At least three years leading the sales compensation design process

• Experience with Customer Relationship Management (CRM) (e.g., Salesforce) and Incentive Compensation Management (ICM) (e.g., Captivate IQ, Varicent, Xactly) tools

• Experience with reporting tools and Tableau

• Strong logic, problem-solving, and Excel modeling skills

• Very organized and attentive to detail, with excellent prioritization skills that allow you to consistently deliver quality results on time

• Experience working in high-growth, performance-focused environments and administering complex programs

• Ability to forge strong bonds, work collaboratively with, and influence internal partners such as other Sales channels, Finance, and Business Applications

Preferred qualifications

• Experience leveraging AI tools to enhance impact and productivity

• Experience in Sales or Sales Operations roles

• SQL programming experience

From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for managing our commercial customer base. The ideal person will be a proactive and curious member of our growing Sales team, identifying new business with prospects and growth opportunities for clients. A certain level of foresight and knowledge working with intrinsic sales cycles will take this individual confidently into the future of dbt Labs. This person will be located in Dublin.

 

In this role, you can expect to:

• Build, manage and close your own pipeline of companies that you believe will benefit from the dbt Cloud offering

• Manage, and deepen the dbt Cloud footprint in existing accounts, optimizing our impact on these companies

• Engage with technology partners and ecosystem service providers to optimize our impact and reach in the region

• Lead and contribute to team projects that develop our sales process

• Work with product to build and maintain the dbt Cloud enterprise roadmap

We’re looking for someone who has:

• Closing experience in technology sales, with a proven track record of exceeding annual targets

• Ability to understand complex technical concepts and develop them into a consultative sale

• Excellent verbal, written, and in-person communication skills to engage stakeholders at all levels of an analytics organization (individual developer up to CTO)

• The diligence and organizational skills to work long, intricate sales cycles involving multiple client teams

jobs.description:

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation

That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own the forward-looking financial plan for the top and mid funnel of n8n’s commercial engine, helping Marketing leadership make sharper investment decisions across both our PLG and SLG motions.

To do so, you’ll turn demand, funnel, and marketing investment decisions into an integrated financial view that leadership can act on:

OWN MARKETING PLANNING & FORECASTING

 - Drive n8n’s annual planning and regular forecasting process for Marketing end to end, from top-down targets and cross-functional alignment through regional segmentation, budget ownership, and consolidation into the company plan.

 - Partner with Marketing budget owners across demand generation, brand, community and DevRel, product marketing, and events to set budgets, forecast spend, and sharpen investment trade-offs.

 - Own program spend with the same rigor as headcount, including agency and media contracts, event and sponsorship commitments, phasing, seasonality, and in-year reallocations.

MODEL FUNNEL & CHANNEL ECONOMICS

 - Model demand creation, signup and MQL volume, activation, qualified opportunity, conversion, and velocity with Marketing Ops and RevOps across both PLG and SLG motions.

 - Translate funnel and channel levers into the demand assumptions behind n8n’s integrated top-line model and quantify the financial impact and trade-offs of changing them.

 - Assess CAC and payback, conversion, pipeline contribution, and expected versus realized ROI using attribution, incrementality testing, and other causal methods where appropriate.

BUILD A RIGOROUS MARKETING INVESTMENT FRAMEWORK

 - Establish a repeatable process for material marketing bets covering hypothesis, baseline, expected return, confidence range, leading indicators, scale-or-stop triggers, and post-investment review.

 - Build and defend investment cases for brand, community, content, events, and other spend that does not attribute cleanly to closed revenue.

 - Use internal evidence, external benchmarks, and post-investment learnings to drive in-year reallocations toward the highest-impact opportunities.

TURN DATA INTO DECISIONS

 - Partner with Marketing Ops, RevOps, Data, and Controlling to keep the financial view aligned with n8n’s attribution, measurement, and reporting frameworks.

 - Own the financial metric definitions behind Marketing reporting and ensure teams are operating from a consistent view of performance.

 - Turn financial reporting and variance analysis into tangible insights and recommendations for Marketing leadership, executives, and board-level audiences when needed.

REQUIREMENTS

MUST-HAVES

 - 📊 FP&A experience: You have 7+ years of experience in FP&A or strategic finance, ideally in a fast-paced technology or B2B SaaS environment.

 - 🗂️ Complex planning experience: You have led complex, multi-entity, multi-stakeholder annual planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes end to end.

 - 🤝 Marketing business partnering: You have deep demand-side finance partnering experience in either a self-serve/PLG funnel or an enterprise/SLG demand generation motion, plus a strong working understanding of the other.

 - 📈 Funnel and channel economics: You are fluent in CAC and CAC payback by channel and motion, blended versus paid CAC, CLV/CAC, pipeline attribution, funnel conversion, and velocity.

 - 🧭 Judgment on unattributable spend: You have built and defended investment cases for brand, community, content, or similar spend that will never attribute cleanly to a closed deal.

 - 💶 Program spend ownership: You are comfortable owning a budget weighted toward program spend, including commitments, phasing, agency costs, vendor economics, and reallocations.

 - 🧮 Financial modeling: You build sophisticated, integrated financial models that remain robust as assumptions, scenarios, and operating inputs change.

 - 🗣️ Executive communication: You translate complex analysis into clear recommendations and are comfortable presenting to Marketing leadership, executives, and board audiences when needed.

 - 🤖 AI- and automation-first mindset: You naturally use AI and automation platforms such as n8n to improve the quality, speed, and repeatability of your planning, reporting, and analysis.

NICE-TO-HAVES

 - 🔄 PLG + SLG fluency: You have deep experience across both product-led and sales-led demand motions rather than primarily one.

 - 🧑‍💻 Developer-focused environment: You have worked at a community-led, open-source, or developer-focused product company.

 - 🧪 Incrementality & experimentation: You have exposure to incrementality testing, holdout design, or marketing mix modeling.

 - 🛠️ Marketing & RevOps tooling: You have

jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is looking for a driven, strategic, and entrepreneurial Sales Development Manager to lead and scale our SDR team across EMEA. This will be the first dedicated SDR leadership role in the region, responsible for building a high-performing team that generates pipeline across leading law firms, professional services organizations, and in-house legal teams.

You will own hiring, onboarding, coaching, and performance management while partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to build a scalable pipeline generation engine. You’ll also help shape Harvey’s regional go-to-market strategy by refining targeting, messaging, and outbound programs that resonate with the European legal market.

If you’re excited by the idea of building teams, developing talent, and driving impact at a fast-growing AI company transforming legal work, we’d love to meet you.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own regional pipeline performance: Drive the SDR team’s contribution to pipeline generation across inbound and outbound channels, ensuring strong alignment with EMEA sales targets.

 - Build and scale the team: Hire, onboard, and develop a high-performing SDR team, helping establish the structure, operating cadence, and performance standards for the EMEA region.

 - Coach and develop SDRs: Deliver hands-on coaching through regular 1:1s, call reviews, and deal strategy sessions to accelerate rep development and performance.

 - Design onboarding and enablement: Partner with GTM enablement to create onboarding and ongoing training programs that ramp SDRs quickly and build strong product, industry, and prospecting expertise.

 - Partner cross-functionally: Collaborate closely with Sales, Marketing, and RevOps to improve lead routing, campaign effectiveness, and pipeline conversion.

 - Refine targeting and messaging: Continuously test and improve outbound strategies, messaging, and account targeting based on ICP fit and performance insights.

 - Leverage data and tools: Use platforms such as Salesforce, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong, and ZoomInfo to track team performance and optimize workflows.

 - Build a strong team culture: Foster a high-performance culture grounded in ownership, learning, and collaboration.

WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 4+ years of experience in SaaS sales or business development, with at least 1–2 years of direct SDR or BDR leadership experience.

 - Proven success in building and managing pipeline-generating teams in a high-growth, outbound-focused environment.

 - Deep understanding of modern sales development tools (e.g., Salesforce, Salesloft, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Gong).

 - A data-driven mindset with the ability to analyze team performance, uncover insights, and iterate quickly.

 - Experience building SDR processes from scratch—comfortable in ambiguity and excited to be the architect of something new.

 - A coaching-first leadership style: you invest in people, celebrate wins, and hold high standards with care.

 - Excellent communication skills and executive presence—both internally and externally.

 - Passion for AI, innovation, and the transformation of knowledge work—especially in professional services and legal.

 - Influence tech stack - develop recommendations and drive implementation

 - Prior experience selling into legal or professional services firms is a plus but not required.

 - Monitor, analyze, and report on DSO, aging, and other AR performance metrics, driving continuous improvement in cash collection timelines.

 - Partner cross-functionally with Revenue Accounting, Deal Operations, Legal, and Customer Success to resolve billing discrepancies and ensure accurate, timely invoicing.

 - Manage and optimize billing systems and tools (e.g., NetSuite) to improve accuracy and efficiency across the order-to-cash cycle.

 - 5+ years of progressive experience in accounts receivable, billing, or order-to-cash management, ideally in a high-growth SaaS or technology environment.

 - Strong working knowledge of collections best practices, credit management, and cash application processes.

 - Proficiency with ERP systems (NetSuite strongly preferred), billing platforms, and Dunnings applications (Tesorio strongly preferred).

jobs.experience: 10+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

About This Role:

As the Director of Customer Support, you will be instrumental in expanding Crusoe's growing Customer Support organization and driving the adoption of Crusoe Cloud. This leadership role demands a strategic thinker who can develop and execute comprehensive account playbooks, ensuring quarter-over-quarter growth. This role requires a leader who is technical, comfortable getting hands on with issues, and confident joining customer calls when needed.

You will build and manage a high-performing support team, fostering a culture of technical excellence and customer advocacy. You will partner closely with engineering, SRE, product, and operations teams to improve reliability, enhance support workflows, and deliver validated, production ready infrastructure to customers..  We’re looking for someone who has built support organizations at scale, implemented support procedures, and knows how to operate in a fast paced, high growth environment.

What You’ll Be Working On:

 - Build, lead, and scale Crusoe’s global Customer Support organization.

 - Develop and implement comprehensive account playbooks to drive Crusoe Cloud adoption and growth.

 - Manage and mentor teams troubleshooting issues across networking, Infiniband, distributed training, containerization, and large scale AI/ML workloads.

 - Work closely with engineering, SRE, and product to improve reliability and proactively address customer impacting issues.

 - Drive initiatives to reduce escalations, incidents, and outages, leveraging key KPIs and observability data.

 - Build and evolve a tiered support structure to support enterprise and AI-native customers at scale.

 - Translate support insights into clear recommendations for executive leadership.

What You’ll Bring to the Team:

 - Leadership & Customer Operations Expertise:
   
   - 8–10+ years in customer support/operations leadership, ideally in cloud, infrastructure, or AI driven environments.
   
   - Proven ability to build and lead high-performing customer support teams.
   
   - Experience building support procedures, global processes, and structured escalation paths.
   
   - Ability to develop and implement customer tier support structures.

 - Technical & Strategic Acumen:
   
   - Technical expertise in one orchestration/scheduling technology, Linux, virtualization, and storage skills.
   
   - Familiarity with AI/ML workloads, distributed training frameworks, and inference systems.
   
   - Ability to speak at a technical level and think strategically about account growth.
   
   - Comfortable working with Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams. 
     

 - Problem-Solving & Collaboration:
   
   - Comfortable stepping into high-pressure customer situations and stabilizing escalations.
   
   - Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and product teams.
   
   - Strong ability to drive initiatives to reduce incidents and improve customer experience.

Key Requirements:

 - Proven experience in building and scaling customer support organizations.

 - Strong understanding of enterprise and tiered support models.

 - Ability to develop and implement strategic account playbooks.

 - Technical proficiency across cloud, Linux, container ecosystems, and/or distributed systems.

 - Excellent communication, leadership, and cross-functional influence.

 - Experience supporting or working with AI/ML infrastructure is a strong plus.

Benefits:

Crusoe also offers a competitive benefits package designed to support financial security, health, and overall well-being, including pension contributions, private health and dental insurance, income protection, life assurance, and more.

 

Compensation:

Compensation will be paid as a salary or hourly. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

Crusoe is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, citizenship, marital status, sex/gender, sexual preference/ orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, national origin, or any other status protected by law or regulation.

jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Hybrid role: 2 days per week on site in Cork

Please apply through the official application link. Direct outreach to Talent Acquisition or hiring managers via email or LinkedIn will not provide an advantage in the selection process.

The Role:  

The GCO Channel Analyst plays a critical role within the GCO Finance organization at Logitech, providing analytical support and financial insights to optimize channel performance, drive revenue growth, and enhance decision-making across our global channel teams.

The primary business interactions are the Global organization and Regional Channel teams. From a functional side, there are frequent interactions with the Cluster Business Finance, Business Operations and Global GTM Finance. 

Your Contribution:  

- Analyze channel sales performance, trends, and profitability across multiple channels and geographic regions,

- Coordinate regular management reports, dashboards highlighting key performance indicators (KPIs) and business insights,

- Support the quarterly regional forecast submissions and provide reporting,

- Monitor and evaluate channel performance, inventory levels,

- Coordinate and optimize financial systems and tools used for channel analytics,

- Maintain the Channel classification mapping across geographies,

- Own Opex for the GCO teams: consolidation and forecast submission, actuals variance analysis, cross-charges,

- Lead constant improvement of our tools and processes.

Your Qualifications and Skills:  

- 3-5 years of progressive development in Finance with prior experience providing Financial Planning & Analysis support. 

- Strong financial modeling skills; proficiency in Hyperion Essbase and Oracle. 

- Experience in Business Finance or Sales Finance and experience in an international environment like FMCG , Consumer electronics is an added plus. 

- Excellent attention to detail and ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. 

- Strong teamwork and interpersonal skills; able to form positive relationships with business partners and peers.

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. Logitech supports a culture that encourages individuals to achieve good physical, financial, emotional, intellectual and social wellbeing so we all can create, achieve and enjoy more and support our families. We can’t wait to tell you more about them being that there are too many to list here and they vary based on location.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, age, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

If you require an accommodation to complete any part of the application process, are limited in the ability, are unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact us toll free at +1-510-713-4866 for assistance and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Global Payroll & Transformation Senior Analyst
jobs.experience: 5+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Position Summary:

 ● Department: Controllership Finance – Global Payroll Team

 ● Location: Cork, Ireland 

● Contract Type: Full Time / Permanent

 ● Region Coverage: EMEA & Global Payroll Transformation (EMEA) 

About the Role: As an integral member of Logitech Finance, you will work in a fast-paced, dynamic Global Payroll team processing payrolls across the EMEA region. You will play a dual role: ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll delivery for selected countries, while acting as a key representative on the Global Payroll Transformation team to re-engineer, automate, and modernize our global payroll operations. 

Your Contribution: Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and Do. 

In this role you will:

 ● Ensure the accurate and timely processing of Logitech’s end-to-end payroll for selected EMEA countries. 

● Collaborate with payroll partners to collect and validate all payroll inputs, including salaries, bonuses, benefits, allowances, and deductions. Conduct rigorous pre- and post-payroll reconciliations to eliminate anomalies or duplicate records before finalization.

 ● Ensure the accurate and timely completion of payroll fiscal close procedures, including journal entries and balance sheet reconciliations. Work with the broader Finance team to identify and resolve payroll accounting exceptions. 

● Understand the full payroll cycle through to GL bookings and present meaningful flux analysis to stakeholders.

 ● Stay current on and ensure strict compliance with local payroll regulations, tax laws, social security, and benefits requirements across various EMEA jurisdictions.

 ● Ensure compliance with payroll internal controls, maintaining robust documentation and proactively identifying and remediating any control gaps or weaknesses. Assist in facilitating internal and external audit engagements.

 ● Partner with key stakeholders including People Services, HRIS, Compensation & Benefits, Stock Admin, and Finance to troubleshoot issues and work collaboratively to develop optimum processes and service delivery.

 ● Drive the Global Finance Transformation roadmap across EMEA, focusing on eliminating manual workflows, standardizing regional processes, and implementing scalable, automated payroll solutions.

 ● Collaborate with internal and external partners to evaluate, test, and deploy emerging technologies to enhance service delivery. 

 Your Skills & Experience:

 Since this role sits directly at the intersection of payroll delivery and global process optimization, it requires an elevated transformation skillset. We are looking for an experienced EMEA payroll professional who pairs deep technical payroll knowledge with a strong technology-first mindset— someone actively passionate about leveraging AI, automation, and data to transform enterprise payroll. For consideration, you must bring the following skills, experience and behaviours to our team: 

● Experience: 5+ years of proven experience in a senior analyst payroll role across the EMEA region. 

● Transformation & Technology Focus: Advanced capability and genuine interest in applying emerging technologies—such as AI, Machine Learning (ML), and Robotic Process Automation (RPA)—to eliminate manual touchpoints, re-engineer workflows, and unlock strategic workforce insights. 

● Education & Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field—or an equivalent payroll certification.

 ● Regulatory Compliance: Solid understanding of EMEA payroll taxes, statutory deductions, social security, and labour regulations across multiple European jurisdictions.

 ● Spreadsheet Skills: Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets (must be comfortable using Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and managing large data sets). 

● Familiarity with how HRIS data flows into downstream payroll and Finance/GL systems. 

● Strong ability to perform pre- and post-payroll reconciliations, investigate gross-to-net variances, and flag data errors before finalization.

 ● Experience supporting month-end close procedures, including preparing journal entries and assisting Finance/FP&A teams with cost analysis. 

● Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to partner effectively across HR, Finance, and external vendors. 

● Ability to stay organized and solve problems independently in a fast-paced, global team environment.

 ● Customer service focus with the ability and sound judgment to handle highly sensitive information. 

● Process improvement mindset: have a passion for reengineering payroll processes in implementing a first-class payroll service. 

ABOUT LOGITECH With a fast-moving, innovative culture and a strong balance sheet, Logitech is a world leader in products that connect people to the digital experiences they care most about. Video conferencing, remote work, content creation, and gaming are long-term secular trends driving our business — and today all of them have accelerated, making Logitech more relevant to customers than ever. Logitech is the sweet spot for people who are passionate about products, making a mark, and having fun doing it. We're small and flexible enough for every person to take initiative — and big enough for those actions to have a global impact

jobs.title: Global Customer Supply Chain Transformation Manager (12-months contract)
jobs.experience: 5+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Location: Utrecht, Netherlands or Cork, Ireland

Working Model: Hybrid (2-3 days/week)

The Team and Role:

At Logitech, Customer Supply Chain (CSC) plays a critical role in delivering an outstanding customer experience while enabling sustainable business growth. As our organization continues to evolve, Global CSC Transformation is focused on accelerating business capabilities, driving process excellence, enabling digital innovation and fostering collaboration across our Global CSC network. 

As the Global CSC Transformation Manager, you will play a pivotal role in supporting and executing the transformation agenda for Global Customer Supply Chain. Working closely with Regional CSC Heads, you will lead strategic, cross-functional initiatives that improve operational excellence, strengthen customer collaboration, accelerate digital and AI adoption, and enhance the capabilities of our global CSC organization.

This is a highly collaborative role that requires exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills. You will partner with Global & Regional CSC Heads, and cross-functional stakeholders across Planning, Commercial, IT, Digital, Data & Analytics and Finance to align priorities, drive execution and deliver meaningful business outcomes. Success in this role depends on your ability to build trusted relationships, influence without direct authority and navigate a highly matrixed global environment.

Beyond delivering transformation initiatives, you will proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, simplify ways of working and introduce innovative solutions that create measurable value for both the business and our customers. You will contribute to the continuous evolution of Global CSC capabilities while helping embed a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement across the organization.

Your Contribution:

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• 

Drive strategic transformation initiatives by leading end-to-end business process redesign (BPR) and evolving operating models to simplify, standardize and optimize the Global Customer Supply Chain organization.

• 

Drive customer-centric transformation by improving customer journey, service experience and cross-functional collaboration across the order-to-cash process. 

• 

Building strong partnerships with Global and Regional CSC Heads and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities and deliver business outcomes.

• 

Identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve ways of working and accelerate organizational capabilities.

• 

Leading cross-functional initiatives that enable digital transformation, AI adoption and process standardization.

• 

Translating business needs into actionable transformation plans and ensuring successful execution and adoption.

• 

Establish governance, KPIs and benefits realization frameworks to monitor progress and transformation value.

• 

Promoting collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement across the Global CSC organization.

• 

Contributing to the development of scalable capabilities that enhance customer experience, operational excellence and long-term business growth.

Key Qualifications:

For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

• 

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations Management or a related field.

• 

5+ years of experience in Business Transformation, Program Management, Supply Chain, Customer Supply Chain, Consulting or related functions.

• 

Project Management and/or Change Management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile, Prosci)with excellent project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

• 

Experience leading complex cross-functional digital transformation initiatives, including process automation and AI-enabled business improvements, in a global matrixed organization. 

• 

Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence across functions and organizational levels without direct authority.

• 

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations.

• 

Excellent communication, presentation and executive storytelling skills.

• 

Strong financial acumen with experience developing business cases, establishing governance and KPIs, and measuring transformation success through ROI and benefits realization.

• 

Demonstrated experience supporting organizational change and driving adoption of new processes, tools or ways of working.

• 

Self-starter with a continuous improvement mindset, strong ownership and the ability to navigate ambiguity.

• 

Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.

• 

Fluent

jobs.title: Senior Engineer Manufacturing
jobs.experience: 30+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc.

People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the Aggregate System and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence.

Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

Job Description:

Position Summary

As a Manufacturing Engineer, you will be a key member of the site engineering team, responsible for ensuring that our high-reliability discrete semiconductor products meet stringent customer, industry, and regulatory requirements. You will own product and process definition through part requirement analysis and test flow selection, ensuring products are correctly processed through electrical screening and sampling operations in accordance with applicable military, aerospace, and internal specification test methods.

You will develop and maintain robust process controls, drive automation initiatives, and contribute to continuous improvement in yield, quality, throughput, and cost of ownership.

The Manufacturing Engineering team in Ennis comprises two disciplines: electrical and mechanical. This position focuses on electrical engineering support for the site, including back-end test and reliability screening operations.

Working Pattern

This is a day shift position. The successful candidate will work Monday - Friday, 08:00 – 16:30.

Why Join Us

You will receive structured in-house training and be coached and mentored by senior engineers with deep expertise in high-reliability semiconductor manufacturing — an excellent platform to build a career in a specialized, high-value segment of the industry.

Role Focus

• Lead and support project work on high-reliability screening operations, including High Temperature Reverse Bias (HTRB), burn-in, and electrical test/screening methodologies.
• Partner with site engineers on equipment appraisal and qualification initiatives, driving process standardization, quality improvement, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) enhancements.
• Develop deep knowledge of products, processes, and test equipment to provide technical direction on product disposition through screening and sampling process steps.
• Ensure compliance with applicable industry test methods, standards, and customer source-control requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Apply reliability engineering theory and principles (e.g., failure mechanisms, acceleration models, screening effectiveness) to Microchip products and manufacturing processes.
• Drive data analysis, statistical process control (SPC), and root cause / corrective action (RCCA) activities to resolve yield, quality, and equipment issues and to sustain continuous improvement.
• Originate and develop technical solutions, process advancements, and automation initiatives that strengthen Microchip's position as an industry leader in high-reliability discrete semiconductors.
• Create and maintain process and product documentation, including test flows, specifications, and associated process controls.

Requirements/Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree (Level 8) in Engineering or Physics; Electronic/Electrical Engineering preferred.
• Exposure to continuous improvement and quality methodologies — Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, DOE, DMAIC, FMEA, SPC — is an advantage.
• Familiarity with semiconductor device physics, discrete power devices (e.g., diodes and bipolar transistors), or ATE/electrical test environments is an advantage but not essential.

Essential Skills and Attributes

• Strong grasp of electrical engineering fundamentals and semiconductor device behavior.
• Demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and apply detailed product and process knowledge.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.

Job Function: 

Supply Chain Engineering

Job Sub Function: 

Manufacturing Engineering

Job Category:

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Limerick, Ireland

Job Description:

Job Position Summary

The Staff Manufacturing Engineer is a senior individual-contributor role providing technical leadership for manufacturing engineering within J&J Vision Care, Limerick. Working in a high-volume, fully automated and highly regulated contact lens manufacturing environment, the Staff Engineer leads complex, high-impact technical initiatives that improve equipment performance, process capability, yield and output, while ensuring operations remain safe, compliant and cost-effective.

The role acts as a subject matter expert and technical authority across one or more value streams, influences technical direction across Engineering, Operations, Quality, R&D and Global Engineering, and coaches and mentors engineers to raise the technical capability of the wider team. The Staff Engineer reports to the Manufacturing Engineering Manager and has no direct line management responsibility, but is expected to lead through influence.

Duties & Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

• Act as the senior technical authority for manufacturing equipment and processes, providing direction on complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis and long-term technical solutions.
• Lead the design, installation, qualification, optimisation and standardisation of lens production processes, equipment, tooling and controls, ensuring solutions are scalable and, where appropriate, deployed across multiple lines and value streams.
• Drive year-on-year improvements in equipment OEE, process capability, yield and output through structured problem solving, data analysis and Lean / Six Sigma methodologies.
• Develop and maintain technical roadmaps for assigned platforms, including obsolescence and aged-asset mitigation, technology upgrades and capability development.
• Provide technical input to capital investment proposals, business cycle planning and cost-saving programmes.

Projects, NPI & Continuous Improvement

• Lead large, cross-functional engineering projects from concept through design, installation, commissioning, validation and ramp-up, including new product introductions (NPI), line conversions and capacity expansion.
• Identify and lead cost, quality and technical improvement initiatives under the site continuous improvement programme, quantifying benefits and delivering to agreed timelines and budgets.
• Apply robust project management governance, providing timely and accurate status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, and introduce those that deliver a measurable benefit to safety, quality, delivery and cost.

Quality, Compliance & EHS

• Ensure all engineering activities conform to corporate, franchise, statutory and regulatory requirements for GMP, EHS and Quality, including change control, equipment qualification and process validation.
• Own or support effective closure of Quality System actions such as CAPAs, non-conformances, audit actions and risk assessments.
• Embed safety and environmental requirements in the purchase, modification and operation of new and existing equipment, including machine safety standards.
• Create, review and approve technical documentation, including specifications, protocols, work instructions and troubleshooting guides.
• Act as a subject matter expert during internal and external audits.

Collaboration, Coaching & Culture

• Partner with Operations, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing and Global Engineering to deliver value stream safety, quality, delivery and cost objectives.
• Build relationships with other J&J sites, equipment vendors and external experts to share best practice and leverage learnings.
• Mentor and coach Associate, Manufacturing and Senior Engineers, supporting their technical and career development.
• Role-model Our Credo and JJVC behavioural standards, and contribute to a high-performance, inclusive team culture.
• Support the Engineering Manager in developing and implementing strategic engineering goals and objectives.
• All employees are responsible for minim

About Johnson & Johnson MedTech Surgery

Fueled by innovation at the intersection of biology and technology, we’re developing the next generation of smarter, less invasive, more personalized treatments. Are you passionate about improving and expanding the possibilities of surgery? Ready to join a team that’s reimagining how we heal?
