Senior Manufacturing Engineer, J&J, Vision, Limerick, Ireland 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Manufacturing Engineer to support manufacturing performance, process capability, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement within a fast-paced, highly automated, and regulated manufacturing environment.

In this role, you will provide strong engineering support across manufacturing operations, helping to improve process capability, equipment performance, quality, and output. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, deliver engineering projects, and implement practical, compliant solutions that support safe, efficient, and reliable manufacturing.

As Senior Manufacturing Engineer, you will:

− Support the deployment of manufacturing and automation solutions that improve process capability, equipment performance, quality, and output within assigned manufacturing areas.

− Support the design, installation, qualification, optimisation, and improvement of manufacturing processes, equipment, tooling, and controls.

− Provide troubleshooting support for process and equipment issues using structured problem-solving, data analysis, and sound engineering judgement.

− Partner with operations, quality, maintenance, validation, supply chain, and other engineering teams to implement robust and compliant manufacturing solutions.

− Identify and deliver continuous improvement initiatives that enhance yield, reduce cost, increase capacity, and improve manufacturing performance.

− Lead or support technical projects from concept through implementation, ensuring clear execution, risk management, and timely communication of progress and outcomes.

− Ensure timely and effective completion of Quality System deliverables including CAPAs, non-conformances, audit actions, change controls, and associated technical documentation.

− Ensure safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements are fully integrated into the design, purchase, modification, and operation of new and existing manufacturing equipment.

− Support plant and engineering strategic initiatives by bringing technical expertise, urgency, and execution focus to critical business priorities.

− Champion a culture of environmental, health, and safety excellence by ensuring all activities are carried out responsibly and in full compliance with site and company expectations.

Essential:

− A bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Process, Automation, or a related Engineering discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

− Minimum of 4 years’ engineering experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, with demonstrated capability in troubleshooting, process improvement, and project delivery.

− The ability to take ownership, work independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.

− Strong communication, teamwork

jobs.experience: 5+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.

.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.

.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Senior Software Engineer.

About the job

This position will be part of a team of talented engineers within our Commerce Platform Team, who build services and products that operate at a massive scale. This platform is central to Twilio's core business as it is responsible for managing the billing lifecycle and payment experience for our customers, while also acting as a gateway for discovering and selling our products. Billing is going through a transformational journey, and we are introducing new and exciting capabilities. The engineer in this role will be part of a team that focuses on the control plane, billing experience and account lifecycle management.

The successful candidate will design, build, and operate core billing platform services that help transition our platform and our customers to the next generation architecture. These services work for all Twilio customers, regardless of their scale and billing complexity.

The ideal candidate will build high-quality, innovative and fully performing software that complies with high levels of coding standards and technical design. This is to build and integrate services that continuously improve our ability to provide products to customers while simultaneously delivering industry leading availability. We do this by leveraging technologies that include AWS cloud infrastructure and APIs, Apache Kafka, Rest APIs (OpenAPI compliance), while also building our own services.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

• Improve your knowledge of highly available and scalable distributed systems and use this knowledge to build new features into our platform.

• Design, implement, and operate both new features on our current services as well as new services that will be built from scratch.

• Leverage your excellent communication and written skills to articulate the "why" of the solution you are proposing, and have a good understanding of your team’s priorities and the customer impact.

• Troubleshoot and fix operational issues and have the opportunity to improve the troubleshooting procedures and tools.

• Execute full software development life cycle (SDLC).

• Develop flowcharts and documentation to identify solutions.

• Write well-designed, testable code.

• Document and maintain software functionality.

• Troubleshoot, debug and upgrade existing systems.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

As a Commerce Platform engineer, you will design and build core platform services, REST APIs and take part in transitioning our platform to next generation architecture. We run on AWS cloud infrastructure and use AWS cloud data store, EKS, Glue, Kafka, Aurora RDS etc.

*Required:

• 5+  years of work experience building highly scalable products.

• 5+ years of programming experience in object-oriented language  (Java or similar) with clean code practices.

• Expert knowledge in Object-Oriented Programming with a successful track record.

•

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Trade Order Management
jobs.experience: 6+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Are you an engineer who enjoys building game-changing software and solving complex technical issues? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment where you can develop new capabilities, improve existing systems, and provide hands-on support to keep critical applications running smoothly? Are you excited to help shape the future of trading by contributing across the full lifecycle—from design and development to troubleshooting and technical support? If so, we invite you to join our team.

As a Ridgeline Staff Software Engineer on our Trading Team, you’ll play a pivotal role in building and supporting high-quality applications for our Trade Order Management solution. Leveraging modern technologies and AI-enabled tools, you’ll help shape an industry-defining platform while also ensuring the reliability, performance, and day-to-day support of critical trading workflows. In this role, your passion for engineering, problem solving, and the financial domain will make a meaningful impact on the future of investment management technology.

As part of the Ridgeline Trading team you will help shape our culture, make a big impact on a small team, and learn what it takes to build a successful company. Our team aims to leave a legacy in an industry primed for change.

At Ridgeline, how we work matters as much as what we build. Ridgeliners act like owners, choose growth over comfort, and communicate with transparency. We assume positive intent, bias toward action, and bring solutions—not just problems. We celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and thrive in a resilient, collaborative, high-performing culture. If the Ridgeline Way excites you, we’d love to meet you.

You must be permitted to work in Ireland, including under EU work authorization, without the need for employer sponsorship.

The impact you will have:

• Contribute technical expertise and design input to a team where product, design, strategy, and engineering collaborate closely

• Participate in the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design reviews through implementation, testing, deployment, and ongoing support

• Build, enhance, and maintain robust, scalable applications powered by AWS and modern backend technologies

• Troubleshoot production issues, investigate technical problems, and help deliver timely, thoughtful support for critical trading workflows

• Partner with internal teams to diagnose root causes, resolve incidents, and improve system reliability and supportability over time

• Coach, mentor, and support fellow engineers while contributing to the delivery of secure, high-performing enterprise applications

• Think creatively, take ownership, seek solutions, and communicate clearly throughout both development and support efforts

• Contribute to a collaborative environment rooted in learning, teaching, transparency, and continuous improvement

What we look for:

• A degree in Computer Science, Information Science, or equivalent

• 8+ years of software engineering experience, including designing, building, and supporting production applications

• 6+ years experience in Java or Kotlin preferred, or equivalent experience in a modern backend language

• Experience applying design patterns, OOAD and SOLID principles, and writing automated unit tests

• Building and supporting cloud-native applications, preferably in AWS

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey, from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Together with Salesforce, the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success, we're building the future of customer experience. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn't a buzzword, it's a way of life. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI and Data Risk
jobs.experience: 10+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
At Vanta, our mission is to help businesses earn and prove trust. We believe that security should be monitored and verified continuously, and we empower companies to practice better security and prove it with ease. Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. 

Our Staff Software Engineers identify key strategic technical initiatives, deliver significant value to our customers and business, and set the tone for engineering excellence and culture. As a Staff Software Engineer on the team based in London, you will play a key role in growing our engineering presence in Europe. You'll partner with product management, product design, and your growing engineering team to drive the discovery and development of privacy, AI, and risk management features that expand Vanta’s value for its customers - working in a domain where technical decisions carry real compliance and data-governance weight, not just product tradeoffs. Your work will accelerate product development and create a consistent customer experience for all of our customer segments.

Vanta’s team and technology surface are growing quickly, and it’s essential that we invest in the right abstractions and systems to enable us to scale with our business.

Our business has found incredible product-market fit and has monetized effectively since the day we signed our first customer. We’re growing at a blistering pace, which presents career-defining opportunities for engineers to accelerate their growth and to contribute to a rapidly-scaling company.

This role is remote-first. For engineers based in the London area, we ask for 2–3 days per week in the office. For engineers based elsewhere in the UK/Ireland, we expect occasional travel to London (roughly once per quarter, <20% of your time).

Vanta has a kind and talented team, and while some have prior security experience, many have been successful at Vanta without it. We’d love for you to join us!

What you’ll do as a Staff Engineer at Vanta:

 - Identify, scope, and lead large technical projects, laying the groundwork for core products to evolve and scale into highly performant, reliable, and customizable systems

 - Design, develop, and own new product functionality and/or infrastructure leveraging modern frameworks and tooling (TypeScript, React, Node.js)

 - Make effective tradeoffs that consider business priorities, user experience, and a sustainable technical foundation

 - Set technical direction that shapes how multiple teams build in the privacy and AI governance spaces - not just a single project's outcome

 - Help stand up and shape engineering practices as we grow our footprint in the UK/Ireland, including interviewing, hiring, and onboarding new teammates

 - Act as a cultural beacon, setting a high bar for engineering culture and excellence, and multiply the impact of the teams around you through mentorship and technical leadership

How to be successful in this role:

 - At least 10 years of industry experience as a software engineer

 - Served as a technical lead for large projects (6+ months in length), including defining the roadmap for complex projects spanning multiple teams and functions

 - Have set technical direction or built systems whose impact extended beyond your immediate team - e.g., shared infrastructure, cross-team standards, or platform decisions other teams built on

 - Built successful SaaS products for both startup and enterprise users

 - Have previous startup experience, or worked in an environment that prioritizes a bias for action

 - Upleveled teams of engineers by mentoring and leading by example

 - Experience working at rapidly scaling startups and large companies, especially with environments that prioritize a bias for action

What you can expect as a Vanta’n:

 - Industry-competitive salary and equity

 - 100% covered medical, dental, and vision benefits with dependents coverage

 - 16 weeks paid Parental Leave for all new parents 

 - Health & wellness stipend

 - Remote workspace, internet, and mobile phone stipend

 - Commuter benefits and lunch allowance for team members who attend the office

 - Pension matching

 - 25 days of Annual Leave per year and unlimited sick time

 - 8 company-paid holidays

 - Virtual team-building activities, lunch and learns, and other company-wide events!

 - Offices in SF, NYC, London, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and Sydney

#LI-remote

At Vanta, we are committed to hiring diverse talent of different backgrounds and as such, it is important to us to provide an inclusive work environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender identity, age, religion, sexual orientation, veteran or disability status, or any other protected class. As an equal opportunity employer, we encourage and welcome people of all backgrounds to apply.

About Vanta

We started in 2018, in the wake of several high-profile data breaches. Online security was only becoming more important, but we knew firsthand how hard it could be for fast-growing companies to invest the time and manpower it takes to build a solid security foundation. Vanta was inspired by a vision to restore trust in internet businesses by enabling companies to improve and prove their security. From our early days automating security monitoring for compliance standards like SOC 2, HIPAA and ISO 27001 to creating the world's leading Trust Management Platform, our vision remains unchanged. 

Now more than ever, making security continuous—not just a point-in-time check— is essential. Thousands of companies rely on Vanta to build, maintain and demonstrate their trust— all in a way that's real-time and transparent.

Referral Instructions

If you are being referred for the role, please contact that person to apply on your behalf.

jobs.description:
As Senior Data Scientist for Engineering Systems you will work independently alongside sharp, generous, and pragmatic engineers from Server Query, Atlas Clusters, and Release Quality, among other teams. Together, we tackle problems spanning resource scaling across the Atlas fleet, safe feature rollout to MongoDB clusters, automated incident response and query engine performance. Join the Platform Data Science team and help us research, prototype and ship machine learning features for MongoDB’s core server, query engine and Atlas, our database-as-a-service cloud offering.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin or Cork for our hybrid working model.

What You'll Do

• Partner with Server Query, Atlas Clusters, Release Quality and other engineers to embed algorithmic rigor and optimization into resource scaling, release-safety and monitoring systems across the fleet and inside query engine

• Deliver production-ready, thoroughly tested statistical and ML algorithms with well-identified limitations that deliver measurable business impact, not just an impressive-sounding methodology

• Own the full feedback loop: instrument model architecture with the metrics needed to track performance and create dashboards in collaboration with our stellar analytics team, collect feedback from users and metrics to diagnose issues or opportunities, and iterate accordingly

• Deliver thoughtful, kind code reviews to your peers and act as a core contributor to internal packages, tooling, and team processes that increase developer productivity

Measures of Success

• In 3 months, you’re familiar with our workflow, have an elementary understanding of our product and what teams we work with. You have delivered small-to-medium improvements to our project portfolio

• In 6 months, you’ve delivered one feature you researched and prototyped from scratch and demonstrated its impact on business metrics of your choice

• In 12 months, you've established a track record of shipping ML-driven improvements to fleet stability, efficiency, or operational automation; deepened working relationships with two or more partner engineering teams; and become a go-to resource for statistical or engineering rigor across the team

Skills & Attributes

• 5+ years of hands-on machine learning model development, working directly with technical stakeholders

• Expertise and track of record working autonomously across the entire machine learning development lifecycle, including prototyping, simulation, tuning and iterating on products in deployment environments with and without dedicated engineering help

• Embraces an object-oriented approach to designing scalable and readable Python codebase, and has experience working with engineers on architecture design of machine learning systems

• Our codebase is primarily in Python and we use AI for developer productivity - but we expect all ICs to review, understand, and be able to redesign any code that ships regardless of whether a human or an AI wrote the first draft

• Takes ownership of team culture: models psychological safety, and - in whatever way suits their style, whether that's a quiet word or a vocal challenge - encourages others to speak up and calls out when the environment isn't living up to it

• Effective at communicating technical ML concepts to non-ML-experts audiences; e.g. able to translate efficacy measurements of ML models and products into tangible business impact metrics

• Master's degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative/computational discipline (computer science, applied mathematics, statistics, physics, operations research, etc.)

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

You will own the vision, strategy, and 12-month roadmap, including how Atlas evolves to support AI agents. AI agents are changing how teams build and operate cloud infrastructure, and this role will shape how Atlas leads that change.

As part of the team, you will propose, design, build and support product features supporting integrations such as AWS Cloud Formation & AWS CDK, Terraform & Vault. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.experience: 4+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
MongoDB is looking for an outstanding person to join our newly created Forward Deployed Engineering team and take on a key role in our extended R&D organization. Forward Deployed Engineering is linking the work of teams engaged on application modernization roles with our Product and Engineering teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

Many organizations have built up large estates of legacy applications. Lack of scalability and resilience, long development times, operating cost, and inability to run on cloud are common issues with these applications. To address these issues, organizations are engaging in large transformational Application Modernisation programs. MongoDB is recognized as the developer data platform of choice for transactional systems that provide the best scalability, resiliency and developer experience in the cloud as well as on premises. Organizations are continuously migrating workloads from these legacy applications to new platforms, often based on microservices, using MongoDB. 

Such transformations are time intensive and often risky. Tooling based on generative AI promises to accelerate these transformations in a way never seen before. Forward Deployed Engineering is responsible for exploring the possibilities of Generative AI  technologies and providing invaluable feedback to MongoDB’s R&D teams to drive future capabilities of MongoDB and the MongoDB ecosystem.

Application Modernization Engineers will work alongside project teams that are executing Application Modernisation projects with customers. The successful candidate will be responsible for evaluation, build, and applying tools in modernization  projects, facilitating the usage of such tools and processes across the different project teams, identifying opportunities for tooling deployment, selecting potential 3rd party tools, contributing to the development of tooling prototypes and helping to shape the product roadmap.

Our ideal candidate will have

• 4+ years of experience as a field engineer or professional services consultant or full stack developer working directly with Enterprise clients 

• Proficiency in Java or C#, and some familiarity with common database access patterns and frameworks in one or more of these languages

• Strong knowledge about enterprise-scale software architectures, application development methodologies, and software deployment and operations

• Experience developing enterprise applications using relational databases, and employing SQL and stored procedures with Oracle, MS SQL Server, Sybase and/or PostgreSQL databases

• Experience of using and developing with MongoDB and JSON based Document models is highly desirable

• Problem solving skills, including the ability to collaborate across disciplines and teams to come up with creative solutions to technical and business challenges

• Willingness to dive into a complex domain, ask the right questions, and bring new software tools and technologies to the table to solve customer problems

• Great communication skills (both spoken and written), within the team and in customer meetings

• Good understanding of Generative AI concepts, tools, and services. Any experience to build new applications/tools using Generative AI is a big plus. That includes Cursor, Claude Code, Gemini, and OpenAI APIs

• And finally, a strong interest in how AI supported toolchains can improve application development

Position Expectations

• Contribute to customer application modernization initiatives at any or all phases of the application lifecycle: assessment and analysis; planning and design; data modeling; application code conversion, development, test and build; integration and release configuration, production operations, application optimisation, and best practices adoption

• Test drive MongoDB migration products to deliver on customer use cases and drive adoption of the product. Deliver concise feedback to the rest of the development organisation

• Work closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence the direction of the MongoDB product roadmap

• Personally execute POCs including developing or extending existing tools when necessary and appropriate for customer success, with an eye towards reusability and eventual integration with our products. These are often on premises at client locations

• Maintain a broad and deep technical understanding of the product line and the underlying technologies and protocols

• Work as part of a wider delivery team comprising consulting engineers from MongoDB Professional Services, project managers, and account teams

• Assist sales teams in evaluating opportunities with prospects and customers

• Willingness to work on site with customers for 7 days per month, which includes regional travel (within Europe)

Success Measures

The Senior Forward Deployed Engineer will be successful in this role when they can execute the following strategic tasks/responsibilities:

• Become an expert level user of MongoDB, and our tools current migration products

• Develop a playbook for customer application modernization engagements, in collaboration with other MongoDB Engineers, Product Management and Engineering

• Communicate complex technical proposals simply and convincingly to a wide range of audiences

jobs.description:
The MongoDB Query Testing Tools Team is hiring Software Engineers who want to join us in building a state-of-the-art distributed query system. Our Team builds tooling that allows us to ship Query Engine features with high confidence in both correctness and performance, making it a great fit if you like seeing your work protect real customers at scale. The team develops advanced testing frameworks (end-to-end testing, fuzzing, property-based testing) as well as performance measurement tools, including high-volume workload generation tools.

The team is part of the Query organization which is responsible for the MongoDB Query Language and the lifecycle of each query, from parsing to optimization to plan selection; our engineers work on maintaining and improving our optimization and execution frameworks and building new query language features to help power our customers' critical workloads. Throughout all our work, our highest priority is always ensuring that customer queries are answered correctly. The successful applicant will be responsible for helping us to maintain the highest standards of quality through rigorous development, testing and automation strategies.

This role can be based out of our Dublin/Cork office, or remotely in Ireland.

We are also open to considering strong candidates at Software Engineer 3 level (i.e the level before Senior).

Candidate Profile

• 5+ years of experience in software development and/or performance engineering

• Fluency in Python, Javascript or Typescript

• Enjoys chasing down difficult problems in a distributed environment

• Able to make complex concepts easy to grasp in written and spoken English

• Able to decompose and solve complex problems and can rapidly iterate by validating new hypotheses and rethinking current assumptions

• Demonstrating hands-on experience working with relational or NoSQL databases is a plus

• B.Sc. in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent practical experience. Advanced degrees of experience in database query engines is a plus

• Experience in developing automation test frameworks is a plus

• Experience in query processing engine testing is a strong plus

• Experience in developing performance test plans and monitoring frameworks is a strong plus

• Background in database query engines or compilers is a strong plus

• C++ experience is nice to have, but not mandatory.

Position Expectations

• Design, develop, and maintain automated testing frameworks, Performance automated tests and internal tooling for the MongoDB query engine

• Collaborate closely with peers to understand new features and functionalities, ensuring testability, test frameworks, tooling and coverage for automating tests of both happy-path and edge-case scenarios

• Provide feedback in code reviews, focusing on the robustness and reliability of code changes

Success Measures

• Within three months, you have gained an understanding of MongoDB's MQL syntax and its semantics, as well as the behavior of our unique query engine. You have contributed to several code bases on Mongodb engine internal tooling

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team 

Collecting and filing sales & indirect taxes is a classic area for technology disruption. Companies selling across countries, states, and even smaller jurisdictions have to navigate through a myriad of tax rates, product-level tax exemptions, filing requirements, and registration obligations. The rules are constantly changing, and not accurately calculating and filing tax can have legal ramifications.

It’s no surprise then that solving tax compliance is a top user request. We launched Stripe Tax as a new SaaS product in 2021 to make tax compliance as effortless as possible. The Stripe Tax team builds the systems and experiences that help businesses understand where they have obligations, calculate the right tax, and automate reporting and filing. We solve this at a global scale for users ranging from ambitious startups to the world’s largest enterprises, whose requirements demand exceptional correctness, extensibility, and operational rigor.

What you’ll do

We’re looking for an experienced technical leader to shape the architecture and technical roadmap for Stripe Tax. You will work alongside leaders across engineering, product, design, operations, and go-to-market teams to turn complex and evolving tax requirements into simple, reliable experiences for millions of businesses. You will lead high-impact, multi-team efforts, make durable technical decisions, and raise the bar for how we build and operate Stripe Tax.

Responsibilities

• Drive the technical strategy and execution for Stripe Tax’s most important and ambiguous product and platform investments, from early exploration through production adoption

• Work backwards from the needs of complex global businesses and evolving tax regulations to identify high-leverage opportunities and shape the product roadmap

• Partner with engineering, product, design, operations, legal, go-to-market, and infrastructure leaders to align teams and deliver cohesive tax experiences across Stripe

• Design and evolve scalable, resilient systems and data models that meet the exceptionally high standards for correctness, auditability, security, and availability required in tax

• Drive interoperability across Stripe products and external tax ecosystems, scrutinizing service boundaries, interfaces, and data contracts to keep the platform extensible

• Raise the engineering bar through hands-on technical leadership, clear decision-making frameworks, operational excellence, and mentorship that accelerates other engineers

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 10+ years of industry software engineering experience building and operating large-scale, distributed systems

• Deep software engineering expertise, with a track record of making sound architectural decisions while remaining hands-on in the code

• A track record of leading complex, multi-team technical programs from ambiguous problem definition through successful delivery and adoption

• The ability to set long-term technical direction, identify the highest-leverage investments, and make progress amid uncertainty and competing constraints

• Exceptional communication and influence skills, with the ability to build alignment among senior technical, product, and business stakeholders without relying on authority

• A commitment to growing other engineers through mentorship, technical feedback, and a culture of rigorous, inclusive, and data-informed decision making

Preferred qualifications

• Experience in tax, financial technology, payments, accounting, financial reporting, or another domain where correctness and regulatory complexity are central

• Experience working directly with large enterprise customers and translating their complex requirements into durable platform capabilities

• Experience designing robust integrations with external systems and APIs, or leading platform work that spans backend services, data, and user-facing experiences

Through our crypto solutions for financial institutions, businesses, governments and developers, we are improving the global financial system and creating greater economic fairness and opportunity for more people, in more places around the world. And we get to do the best work of our career and grow our skills surrounded by colleagues who have our backs. 

If you’re ready to see your impact and unlock incredible career growth opportunities, join us, and build real world value.

About the Cash Forecasting team:

Cash Forecasting is our AI-amplified treasury solution that helps CFOs and treasury teams move beyond error-prone spreadsheets to achieve real-time cash visibility and predictive accuracy.

The platform integrates seamlessly with major ERPs and banking systems to automatically capture, categorise, and analyse transactional data across multiple currencies and business units. Leveraging our proprietary GSmart AI technology, the solution continuously learns from historical cash flows, sales data, and treasury information to automatically select optimal forecasting algorithms and improve accuracy by over 30%.

You'll work on sophisticated Ruby on Rails and React software that turns diverse financial data into clear analysis, giving customers sharp insight and forecasting through intuitive dashboards. This is a critical platform moving over $100 billion in daily cash flow for enterprise customers across 40+ countries, built to hold enterprise-grade security and scalability at that scale, every single day.

What You’ll Do:

• Design, build, and maintain backend services and APIs that power the Cash Forecasting platform, while remaining comfortable picking up frontend work when the task calls for it

• Work across a large, sophisticated, multi-tenant SaaS codebase, writing code that's built to scale across enterprise customers and their data

• Own the data layer, schema design, query performance, and data integrity - with a strong emphasis on PostgreSQL and SQL more broadly

• Write and maintain thorough test coverage using RSpec, treating testing as a first-class part of delivery

• Package and deploy services using Docker, and work within our AWS-based cloud infrastructure

• Write scripts and tooling to automate repetitive work, support data migrations, and keep the team moving quickly

• Instrument the systems you build with strong observability practices -logging, metrics, and tracing — to catch and resolve issues before they impact customers

• Benchmark and profile code to identify performance bottlenecks, and make evidence-based decisions about where to optimise

• Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and fellow engineers to translate business and customer needs into robust technical solutions

• Participate in code reviews and technical design discussions, contributing to the team's overall growth and improvement

• Be a champion of the YBIYRI ethos (you-build-it-you-run-it), which includes participating in the on-call pager rotation

What You'll Bring:

• 4-8 years of professional software development experience, ideally including full-stack work with a backend lean

• Strong SQL fundamentals; hands-on experience with PostgreSQL ideal

• Comfortable working within large, sophisticated, existing codebases and making changes safely

• Scripting ability for automation and tooling (language-agnostic)

• Experience with Docker or other containerisation technologies

• Proven Git proficiency, including collaborative branching workflows

• Proficiency in at least one major programming language (such as Ruby, Python, or Java)

• Experience employing AI tools throughout the development lifecycle to speed up problem-solving and delivery

• Experience testing with RSpec

Preferred Knowledge / Experience:

• Experience with Ruby or Ruby on Rails is a strong plus - while we value the ability to learn quickly across languages, familiarity with our primary stack will help you ramp up faster.

• Frontend experience, ideally with React, and the ability to contribute there when needed

• Experience with, or solid understanding of, AWS

• Experience building or maintaining multi-tenant, enterprise SaaS platforms

• Familiarity with observability tooling and practices (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting)

• Experience benchmarking and profiling code for performance

• Experience in the financial industry, particularly treasury, payments, FX, or ERP systems

WHO WE ARE:

Do Your Best Work

• The opportunity to build in a fast-paced start-up environment with experienced industry leaders

jobs.description:

Job Description:

Shape the Next Generation of FPGA and SoC Technology

We are seeking an experienced SoC Validation Engineer to lead silicon bring-up, system validation, and debug activities for advanced FPGA and SoC products. Working across hardware, firmware, and system architecture teams, you will drive features from prototype through production, ensuring robust, high-quality solutions for our customers.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges, developing embedded software, and uncovering root causes in both lab and silicon environments.

What You'll Do

• 

Lead SoC validation, silicon bring-up, and system-level debug activities.

• 

Develop validation plans, diagnostic software, and bare-metal firmware for ARM Cortex-M and RISC-V platforms.

• 

Debug complex hardware, firmware, and system interactions using industry-standard lab equipment and tools.

• 

Validate key interfaces and subsystems including PCIe, Ethernet, USB, SPI, I²C, UART, timers, and watchdogs.

• 

Collaborate closely with architecture, RTL, verification, firmware, and physical design teams.

• 

Drive root-cause analysis and resolution of issues discovered in simulation, emulation, FPGA prototypes, and silicon.

• 

Mentor junior engineers and contribute to technical excellence across the team.

• 

Leverage automation and AI-assisted development tools to improve validation efficiency and productivity.

Requirements/Qualifications:

Required

• 

Master's degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering with 12+ years

• 

Strong background in FPGA/SoC architectures, silicon validation, and system-level debug.

• 

Experience developing embedded software in C/C++ and bare-metal firmware for ARM Cortex-M and RISC-V processors.

• 

Hands-on laboratory experience using oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, protocol analyzers, and FPGA debug tools.

• 

Knowledge of JTAG, SVF, IEEE 1532, STAPL, and common embedded peripherals and interfaces.

• 

Familiarity with Verilog/VHDL and FPGA development flows.

• 

Excellent communication skills and a passion for quality engineering.

Preferred

• 

High-speed SERDES bring-up and debug experience.

• 

Knowledge of PCIe Gen3/4/5, Ethernet, USB 3.x, JESD204C, Interlaken, or related protocols.

• 

Experience with Git, Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence, Perl, or Tcl.

• 

Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering

Why Join Us?

You'll work at the forefront of FPGA and SoC innovation, tackling challenging validation problems and helping bring cutting-edge silicon products to market. This role offers exceptional technical breadth across hardware, firmware, system validation, and high-speed interfaces, with strong opportunities for growth and technical leadership.

Travel Time:

0% - 25%

To all recruitment agencies: Microchip Technology Inc. does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our recruiting team or other Microchip employees. Microchip is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

Job Description:

Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst

 

Join a mature international team analyzing cyberthreat information from a variety of sources to produce intelligence which effectively communicates threats relevant to Fidelity.

 

We are seeking a Senior Cyber Threat Intelligence Analyst to join our team to identify, track, and report on cyberthreats relevant to Fidelity. This role sits at the intersection of threat analysis and technical knowledge, requiring someone who can translate raw cyber threat data into actionable intelligence for both operational and executive audiences.

 

• Triage and enrich indicators of compromise (IOCs), perform basic threat hunting and integrate with security tooling including a threat intelligence platform.
• Ingest, normalize, and correlate structured (e.g., IOC feeds) and unstructured data (e.g., OSINT, dark web, reports) to produce actionable threat intelligence and support detection and response efforts.   
• Assist analysts and incident response during cyber investigations.
• Identify and assess the potential impact of cyberthreat activity, including exploits of vulnerabilities and impact within the financial industry. 
• Evaluate and apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Large Language Model (LLM) technologies to expand the cyberthreat intelligence team’s collection, enrichment and analytic capabilities.
• Perform open-source intelligence (OSINT) collection and analysis across dark web forums, social media and threat feeds.
• Map adversary behavior at a granular level and collaborate with stakeholders to develop or refine detection rules and threat mitigation steps.
• Produce finished intelligence products including strategic briefings and tactical advisories tailored to varied audiences (executive management, security operations center, fraud and other stakeholders).
• Participate in information-sharing communities and coordinate with FS-ISAC and trusted industry partners. 

• Qualifications

Required
• 3+ years of experience in cyber threat intelligence, incident response, or a related security discipline.
• Demonstrated knowledge of named threat actors, Tactics Techniques and Procedures and current threat landscape trends.
• Familiarity with intelligence analysis frameworks and structured analytic techniques (e.g., Diamond Model, Kill Chain, Intelligence Cycle, MITRE ATT&CK, STIX).
• Experience producing written intelligence products for both technical and non-technical audiences.
• Comfort and experience with structured and unstructured data, including indicators, metadata, and contextual threat information.
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work productively as part of a team and alongside key stakeholders.

Desired
• Strong technical curiosity, including a willingness to explore, experiment, and ask “why” and “how” to drive deeper understanding of cyberthreat events and new technology.
• Knowledge of Mac endpoints and associated threats.
• Experience leveraging AI/LLM tooling to accelerate intelligence workflows.
• Knowledge of Threat Intelligence Platform integrations, API connectors, and automation pipelines. 
• Industry certifications such as GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Security + and other related credentials.
• Basic scripting or automation experience (e.g., Python or similar) is a plus.
• Knowledge of geopolitical concerns and issues of countries hosting Fidelity businesses and associates.
• Familiarity with malware analysis concepts (static and dynamic), threat hunting, and, at a broad level, how cybercriminals operate. 
• Prior experience in financial services, critical infrastructure, or government intelligence environments. 
• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to work productively as part of a team and alongside key stakeholders. 
• Presentation skills, verbally communicating threats to both technical and non-technical audiences and using slides effectively. 
• Hands‑on exposure to active nation‑state and cybercriminal threat activity, coupled with practical experience using emerging AI tools and features.
• Opportunity to build new capabilities.undefinedSupport for training, conferences, and certification pursuits.
• A collaborative team environment focused on continuous learning and professional development.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

The Role

Are you passionate about building innovative products that transform customer experiences? We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our Contact Center Platform Engineering team. In this role, you will design, develop, and deliver enterprise-scale Workforce Management application that power Fidelity’s contact center operations, enabling associates to provide exceptional service to millions of customers across voice, chat, and digital channels.

As a key technical contributor, you will help shape architectural decisions and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions using Java/Spring Boot and React. You will collaborate closely with product owners, architects, and cross-functional engineering teams to build the next generation of contact center technology, while also mentoring developers and contributing to engineering best practices and technical strategy.

 

The Expertise & Skills You Bring

 

• 5+ years of experience in software development with a focus on full stack engineering.
• Strong proficiency in Java and Spring Boot for backend development.
• Proficiency in React (or modern JavaScript frameworks) for building responsive, component-based UIs.
• Experience with REST API design and development.
• Demonstrated experience designing and building distributed systems.
• Working knowledge of event-driven architecture patterns.
• Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals: design patterns, automated testing, observability, and CI/CD.
• Strong understanding of secure engineering practices (authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets management, secure service communication).
• Proficiency with RDBMS or NoSQL databases.
• Experience with Agile/SAFe development methodologies.
• Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, OpenAI Codex) in real engineering workflows.
• Ability to contribute to design discussions, perform code reviews, and mentor junior developers.
• Excellent problem-solving skills and ability to work independently.
• Strong communications skills and ability to collaborate across teams.
• Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.

 

Preferred Qualifications

 

• Experience with Apache Kafka or similar streaming platforms.
• Working knowledge or experience in Workforce Management domain.
• Familiarity with SIP, WebRTC, and CTI protocols.
• Familiarity with test automation frameworks (Junit, Jest, Playwright, React Testing Library).
• Knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and responsive design.
• Previous experience mentoring junior engineers.
• Experience operating in a service ownership model (full lifecycle responsibility).
• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).

 

The Team

The Contact Center Platform Engineering team develops and maintains the platforms that power Fidelity’s contact center ecosystem, enabling seamless, high-quality interactions across millions of customer engagements. We build and support systems spanning agent desktops, routing platforms, IVR capabilities, real-time service experiences, and Workforce Management.

Our team operates in a fast-paced, highly collaborative environment where innovation, ownership, and customer obsession are central to our success. Engineers on this team play a critical role in shaping the future of contact center technology while delivering resilient, scalable solutions that directly impact customer experience.

jobs.experience: 5+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

The role: 

Data Engineer with proven expertise in real-time data platforms, Snowflake, AWS, data modelling, and analytics-focused data engineering.

Location: Galway

Ways of Working: in Office

We are seeking a Data Engineer to help build and evolve the analytics platform that powers reporting, workforce planning, forecasting, operational insights, and modernization initiatives across the Fidelity Contact Center ecosystem. The Contact Center platform services over 20M clients and processes more than 35M customer interactions per year while operating on a 24x7 basis.

This role focuses on designing scalable data models, developing cloud-native and event-driven data solutions, and delivering trusted, analytics-ready data products on Snowflake and AWS. The ideal candidate combines strong data modeling expertise with modern software engineering and cloud-native development practices.

 

The Expertise We’re Looking For 

 

• 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or Data Platform Engineering.
• Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or related field.
• Strong experience in data modeling, including dimensional modeling and analytical data design.
• Expertise in SQL development, query optimization, and performance tuning.
• Hands-on experience with Snowflake and modern cloud data platforms.
• Expertise with read/write-intensive OLTP databases and/or Operational Data Stores (ODS).
• Experience with real-time or near-real-time data platforms, databases, or processing systems would be of benefit.
• Experience designing analytics-ready datasets for reporting, forecasting, and business intelligence.
• Experience with AWS services and cloud-native architectures.
• Knowledge of data warehousing, distributed systems, and modern data architectures.
• Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

 

The Skills You Bring

 

• Data Modeling (Conceptual, Logical, Physical, Dimensional)
• Snowflake (Data Sharing, Snowpipe, Streams, Tasks, Dynamic Tables, Security)
• SQL and Data Warehousing
• AWS (S3, Lambda, SNS, SQS, IAM, Aurora/RDS, ECS/EKS, CloudWatch)
• Kafka, Kinesis, or other streaming platforms
• REST APIs and integration patterns
• CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform/OpenTofu/CloudFormation)
• Monitoring, Alerting, Observability, and Production Support
• Data Governance, Metadata Management, Security, and Data Masking
• Experience building enterprise analytics platforms on Snowflake and AWS.
• Experience with Power BI, Tableau or similar tools.
• Experience with Collibra, Alation, or other data governance platforms.

 

Your Key Responsibilities

 

• Design and implement conceptual, logical, and physical data models that support analytics, reporting, forecasting, and operational decision-making.
• Develop and maintain analytics-ready datasets and curated data products in Snowflake.
• Build event-driven data pipelines and integrations using AWS and streaming technologies.
• Partner with business and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable data solutions.
• Implement data quality, monitoring, observability, reconciliation, and resiliency capabilities.
• Apply data governance, security, privacy, and access-control best practices.
• Automate deployments and operational processes using CI/CD and Infrastructure-as-Code.

• Support and continuously improve critical production data platforms.
• Knowledge of data warehousing, distributed systems, and modern data architectures.
• Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and DevOps practices.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

 

Success in the Role

 

The successful candidate will help build the data foundation that powers Contact Center modernization by delivering scalable, governed, and analytics-ready data products that support reporting, workforce planning, forecasting, operational insights, and future AI-driven capabilities.

 

For more like this search #DE

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Join Fidelity as a Principal Software Engineer - Technical Lead within our Asset Management Technology group. You will play a key role in shaping technical direction, engineering standards, and the delivery of modern microservices and user interfaces supporting investment solutions managing over $950bn in assets.

 

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

 

You have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or equivalent and are passionate about continuous learning and technology innovation.

 

Required Experience

• Minimum 10 years of software design and development experience.
• Strong experience with Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful services.
• Experience with Angular or a similar front-end framework.
• Experience designing and developing microservices-based applications.
• Experience working within Agile teams and delivering incremental business value.
• Understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD tools such as Maven and Jenkins.

 

Preferred Experience

• Experience with automated testing tools such as Karate, Playwright, Storybook, or similar frameworks.
• Experience with Oracle SQL and PL/SQL.
• Exposure to AWS and/or Kubernetes.
• Exposure to messaging technologies such as Kafka.
• Investment Management or Financial Services domain knowledge.

 

As a Technical Lead, You Will

• Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentoring to engineers across the team.
• Promote engineering excellence through code reviews, automation, testing, and DevOps best practices.
• Contribute to architecture and design decisions for business-critical applications.
• Partner with Product Owners, Architects, and stakeholders to deliver high-quality solutions.
• Help establish and maintain engineering standards across the team.

 

We Are Looking for Someone Who

• Manages priorities effectively across multiple workstreams.
• Can triage issues, perform root cause analysis, and make sound decisions in complex or time-sensitive situations.
• Champions best practices in software engineering, CI/CD, automation, testing, and code quality.
• Builds strong relationships and collaborates effectively with distributed teams and stakeholders.
• Thrives in a collaborative, fast-paced, and agile environment.

 

The Team

In this role, you will contribute to the development of technology solutions used by Portfolio Analysts and Portfolio Managers supporting more than $950 billion in assets under management across Retirement and College Savings solutions.

You will help enhance a suite of microservices and user interfaces that provide portfolio construction, modelling, and trading capabilities. Working within a modern engineering environment, you will contribute to scalable, resilient solutions while helping shape the future direction of our technology platform.

 

Why Join Us?

• Influence technical direction and engineering standards within a highly collaborative team.
• Work on business-critical platforms supporting large-scale investment solutions.
• Contribute to modern engineering practices including microservices, automation, CI/CD, cloud technologies, and DevOps.
• Partner with talented engineers and business experts in a dynamic and innovative environment.
• Help deliver technology that supports millions of investors in achieving their long-term financial goals.

Senior Data Scientist

Senior Data Scientist, Test and Learn 

Overview 

The Services team is a key differentiator for Mastercard, providing cutting-edge products and services that help our customers. Focused on thinking big and scaling quickly around the globe, this agile team is responsible for end-to-end solutions for a diverse global customer base including issuers, acquirers, and merchants. Centered on data-driven technologies and innovation, these services include payments-focused consulting, loyalty and marketing programs, business experimentation and optimization (Test & Learn), and data-driven information and risk management services.

Test & Learn 

As a member of the Test & Learn team, you will pioneer industry-leading experimentation software which brings sophisticated analytic techniques to businesses and users around the world. We are rapidly building new products, improving existing products, and expanding the ways we deliver Test & Learn to our clients. We are looking for innovators who can execute and evolve our analytic strategy, tackling the big challenges of the future. This role will focus on analytic research; pushing the boundaries for our analytics by finding ways to apply new data science methods to top business challenges and translating it into novel products, and scalable commercial solutions.  

Position Responsibilities 

Drive the research of new functionality within an analytics platform used by the world's largest organizations to make critical, multi-million-dollar decisions. 

Work cross-functionally with product management to understand and solve customer needs requiring novel analytic solutions 

Work hand-in-hand with engineering teams to help guide the implementation of your analytic ideas into our products 

Collaborate with leaders across the business unit to identify problems and drive innovative solutions. 

All About You 

5+ years experience in data science OR equivalent graduate coursework.

Experience of applying machine learning, causal inference, and/or generative and agentic AI to real world problems.

Strong technical aptitude and ability to understand complex technical concepts, coupled with strong business acumen to identify applications of technology to solve commercial questions 

Experience applying innovative analytics to high volume datasets to influence business decisions 

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. 

Exceptional project management and problem-solving ability, with a focus on setting ambitious and achievable goals, managing timelines across multiple workstreams, and prioritizing risk/benefit tradeoffs.  

Enthusiastic about opportunities to collaborate with and mentor teammates to foster a supportive and growth-oriented team culture. 

Degree(s) in statistics, mathematics, computer science, engineering, or similar area preferred

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

• 

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

• 

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

• 

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

• 

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

 

Currently, we have a few open positions from our client, an AI-native cloud company. AI teams use its platform to run inference on open-source models, fine-tune them and rent large GPU clusters. The fleet is set to grow about 10×; the team won't. That's where you come in.

 

Who they’re looking for: Site Reliability Engineer, Senior Back-end Developer with Golang, Senior Back-end Developer with Python, AI Infrastructure Engineer, Distributed Storage Engineer, DevOps.

 

Requirements for Senior Back-end Developers with Golang

• 5+ years of commercial experience with Golang

• 2+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes

• 1+ year of experience in AI-assisted coding

• Experience with distributed systems

 

Requirements for Senior Back-end Developers with Python

• 

5+ years of commercial experience with Python

• 

2+ years of commercial experience with Linux

• 

2+ years of commercial experience with Kubernetes

• 

1+ year of experience in AI-assisted coding

• 

Experience with distributed systems

• 

You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue, design and build the solution, and ship it to production

• 

You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster processing, lower costs, more users, fewer incidents)

• 

Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your decisions, raise issues early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls

• 

You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision

• 

You onboard quickly and start shipping in your first weeks

 

Other job listings you can check using the link. You will be redirected to the career page with offers from the client on our website.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer – Distributed Systems & Networking
jobs.experience: 5+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Toast is a rapidly growing company that's revolutionizing how the restaurant industry does business by pairing technology with an extraordinary commitment to customer success. We help restaurants streamline operations, increase revenue, and deliver amazing guest experiences through our platform that combines restaurant point of sale, team management, guest-facing technology, and award-winning customer support. Join us as we empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive.

We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer with strong experience building and operating distributed systems to join the team that connects Toast's customers, services, and infrastructure. Every request to Toast depends on that connectivity, and you'll write software that improves the reliability and scalability of the systems behind it, from customer-facing traffic to service-to-service communication.

Traffic and the number of services at Toast are growing rapidly, so the team is scaling the infrastructure that connects them while keeping it dependable. This is an opportunity to apply your software engineering experience to network and traffic problems at scale. If you're excited to build the foundations for how Toast's services connect, working closely with teammates in the US, we'd love to hear from you.

 

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

• Design, build, test, deploy, and operate software that helps Toast's services connect and route traffic reliably.

• Improve the scalability, resilience, and observability of critical systems as Toast grows.

• Take end-to-end ownership of systems, making changes safer to roll out and failures easier to detect, diagnose, and resolve.

• Investigate production issues, participate in on-call, and turn what we learn into lasting improvements.

• Collaborate with engineers across Toast on projects that span services and infrastructure.

• Contribute to technical designs and raise team standards through thoughtful code reviews and technical discussions.

• Mentor and provide technical guidance to other team members.

• Use AI tooling as a genuine part of your workflow, not an afterthought.

**This is a hybrid role requiring two days a week in the office

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• 5+ years of back-end software engineering experience in Kotlin or another relevant language.

• Strong experience with distributed systems, including designing for reliability, diagnosing failures, and scaling services.

• Experience owning and operating production systems, with solid instincts around testing and code quality.

• A track record of tackling ambiguous, high-impact challenges and delivering scalable solutions.

• Curiosity about how traffic moves through large-scale systems, and the motivation to learn quickly and apply what you learn.

• Clear communication and a collaborative approach to working across teams and time zones.

 

What will help you stand out (Nonessential Skills/Nice to Haves)

• Experience building platforms or infrastructure used by other engineering teams.

• Familiarity with network or traffic-management concepts such as routing, load balancing, DNS, or HTTP.

• Experience with AWS, infrastructure as code (such as Terraform), or cloud networking.

• Experience with service meshes (such as Envoy or Istio) or operating high-availability traffic systems.

 

Our Tech Stack

• Backend services written primarily in Kotlin

• A service mesh with an xDS control plane for service-to-service traffic

• AWS networking, including VPCs, transit gateways, and load balancers

• Terraform and Atlantis for infrastructure as code

• Cloudflare for edge routing and DNS

• AI-assisted development tools as part of daily engineering

 

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

 

Our Total Rewards Philosophy 

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at

With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

As Fivetran scales its Enterprise business, we're looking for a senior individual contributor – with a strong bias towards AI automation – to own the International Demand Generation across EMEA and APAC. You'll be the right hand to the Director of Global Enterprise Demand, driving lead generation to ensure we have the touchpoints and MQL volumes needed to hit Enterprise sales targets. You’ll build and run the always-on 1-to-many ABM engine for Enterprise accounts in EMEA and APAC: agent-driven workflows that turn account signals (intent, tech stack, CRM stage) into campaigns, creative, and landing pages.

This is a strategy-and-execution role: you'll set the plan and roll up your sleeves with the team to make it work.

Location and work model: In person in Dublin, Ireland.

What You’ll Do

You'll co-own the EMEA and APAC enterprise pipeline number alongside the EMEA marketing team, with accountability for lead generation, territory hydration, and the touchpoint and MQL volumes needed to support sales targets. You'll execute account-specific programs to drive account engagement, lead generation and monitor the funnel from touchpoints through qualified opportunities and pipeline. You will own key paid channels, like LinkedIn and Meta, to drive these outcomes. Things you will build: 

• Agentic workflows, using Claude or similar harnesses, that creates, launches, and optimizes LinkedIn and Meta campaigns across target-account tiers.

• Connections between ad platforms, Salesforce, and signal sources such as intent and tech-stack data, so audiences and creative update without manual list uploads.

• A weekly review loop where the system and you assess what worked and improve it.

You'll work across lifecycle marketing, customer marketing, ABM, product marketing, and regional teams to orchestrate integrated programs. Partnering with the Director of Global Demand and Regional Marketing and ABM leaders, you'll improve the demand operating model across EMEA and APAC.

What success looks like

• 6 months: target-account tiers and signals defined; an agent-assisted campaign workflow live for a first segment, with measurable gains in launch speed and cost per touchpoint or MQL.

• 12 months: the engine runs across the EMEA and APAC Enterprise account list with BDR handoff, and it improves itself through a regular review loop. Pipeline influence and BDR conversion on engaged accounts are tracked.

Skills We’re Looking For

Deep, hands-on expertise in paid media and account-based marketing for enterprise buyers (LinkedIn required), plus experience in at least one of lifecycle, customer, or product marketing.

Experience running multi-lifecycle stage campaigns targeting enterprise buying committees

jobs.title: Senior Corporate Security Operations Analyst
jobs.experience: 3+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Corporate Security Operations Analyst

Overview

Mastercard is seeking a Senior Vulnerability Analyst to manage the Bug Bounty Program and perform advanced application security testing across web, mobile, and API environments. This role is responsible for validating externally reported vulnerabilities, conducting penetration testing, partnering with engineering teams on remediation, and helping strengthen Mastercard's security posture through proactive security assessments and vulnerability management.

Role

•	Manage the Bug Bounty Program, including vulnerability intake, validation, triage, and researcher engagement.

•	Conduct penetration testing of web, mobile, and API-based applications.

•	Assess risk, prioritize findings, and provide remediation guidance.

•	Partner with product and engineering teams to drive timely remediation and validate fixes.

•	Develop reporting and metrics to measure program effectiveness and communicate risk.

All About You

•	At least 3 years of experience in application security and penetration testing

•	Strong knowledge of web, mobile, and API security, including OWASP Top 10 risks.

•	Hands-on experience with tools such as Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, or similar testing platforms.

•	Ability to assess vulnerabilities, communicate risk, and provide actionable remediation guidance.

•	Strong stakeholder management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

•	Experience with bug bounty or vulnerability disclosure programs and relevant security certifications is a plus.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

• 

Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

• 

Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

• 

Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

• 

Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
